gap_classes.EVIDENCE_GAP: Existing modeled capability could close the frontier gap if applicability evidence were collected.
gap_classes.MODEL_GAP: Applicable registered capability exists but lacks a qualified effect model.
gap_classes.CAPABILITY_GAP: No current registered/effect-modeled primitive can attack the binding gap.
gap_classes.CONTRACT_GAP: Known actions can meet memory only by violating another task contract.
gap_classes.FRONTIER_REACHED: Existing primitives already reach the target; no new mechanism research.
